name: Joris Marsh
role: Watchman lost to the burn: Berserk, held in the Collarhouse cellar under Halda's roof
appearance: A Redcollar gone grey-veined at the wrists, eyes red in poor light, restrained in the cellar.
voice: None now: snarling and the grind of teeth, no words. Before the burn: a steady gate-watch voice that sang flat in the mess.
backstory: A Watchman wounded by the Gallowsbird's blood on the night of the Great Pyre while the Watch funnelled the crowd. One of seven confined raging in the Collarhouse cellar; five were quenched on day 3. He and Gwenet Marlow were Berserk with no lucid window and have been left. Okton will not quench them without a lucid yes and sits with them waiting for one. Halda keeps them under her roof.
wants: Nothing he can say; the rage wants the nearest living thing. Under it, if anything is left, to go home.

relationships.how: his Watch-Captain, who keeps him in her cellar
the giant who sits with him waiting for a lucid yes
fellow Watchman in the next restraints

dm_only: Under the locked rules the weak (class level 3 or lower, or CR 1/2 or lower) die at the end of Berserk; he is a Guard (CR 1/8). Okton told Chadickith the lost ones fail within a few days if the rage never lets go, yet it is now day 12 and Joris still lives: the ashblood lore marks the timing as open (decide when it matters, and record it).
Okton quenches only with a lucid yes. No Quenching numbers are recorded here.
Invented by npc-creator: age, appearance, the restraints, and that he was wounded funnelling the crowd (canon: seven Watchmen were confined raging after the roc).

statblock.notes: Berserk from the burn: the rage never leaves, no saves, no choices. He attacks the nearest creature and is held in restraints in the Collarhouse cellar.
